source.note: phoneDSH-owned observation-envelope vectors; there is no dsh-bot upstream file.

delta: Freeze the system-generated observation envelope added at tools/post-execute for external tool results; the envelope is not a model-authored prefix.
Freeze the exact attribute order (source, origin, at, owner, ref), the one-line header, the body escaping rule and the fail-closed decode rules.

Only these origin categories are envelopes: web fetch/search, external MCP connectors, ADB/BLE device output, device task results, subagent results, other Bot messages and attachment content. A bash result produced in the Bot box is never wrapped.
